posts.text_html:
🎮 Introducing ObsiGama - a gaming universe inside Obsidian!

Who said Obsidian should only be about notes and productivity?

I've been working on something pretty ambitious: ObsiGama, my own social gaming platform built directly into Obsidian. Think of it as a miniature Steam, but right inside your vault!

Discover games, build your personal library, create a player profile, connect with friends, track your statistics, and collect achievements and badges. Leaderboards and more social features are also on the roadmap!

And the best part? Two games already exist! 🎮


🔫 HELLVAULT - a Doom-inspired FPS where your notes become monsters and your vault turns into a battlefield.

🕹 Mini Old Games - 12 classic mini-games, including Snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy Bird, Breakout, Pong, Whack-a-Mole, Memory, Space Invaders, Sudoku, Simon.

Both games work independently and offline. Connecting to ObsiGama is completely optional, allowing you to sync your progress, statistics, and achievements to your gaming profile.

💜 And this is only the beginning!

My vision is to build an entire gaming ecosystem where developers can publish their own games, players can discover new experiences, and the Obsidian community can connect through gaming.

After all, who said a note-taking app couldn't have its own gaming universe?


Explore the project: 💎 Obsidian.md | 😺 Github

HELLVAULT is officially out! 🎮💜

Who said Obsidian was only meant for taking notes?

My new open-source plugin turns your vault into a Doom-style FPS, where notes become monsters, broken links come alive, and a mysterious corruption threatens to erase everything!

Explore 5 unique zones, fight bosses, collect obsidian shards, and uncover hidden secrets. Choose between 3 game modes, wield 3 weapons, and unlock 21 achievements!

Play completely offline, with English and Russian support.

Mini Old Games is officially out! 🎮

Who said Obsidian has to be all about productivity?

My new plugin brings 12 classic mini-games straight into your vault, including Snake, Tetris, 2048, Minesweeper, and more!

Play offline, choose your difficulty, track your stats, and unlock 67 achievements. No ads, no accounts, just a little nostalgia whenever you need a break.

Available on desktop and mobile, with English and Russian support.

✅ NF-Calendar Is Now Available!!

I'm pleased to announce the first public release of NF-Calendar, an independent plugin for Obsidian designed to make managing daily notes more flexible and automated, completely eliminating any routine involved in their creation.

Going beyond the traditional calendar, NF-Calendar offers smart template rules, highlighting of specific important days right on the calendar, automatic note creation, activity statistics, and everything you've been missing in all the currently popular calendar plugins.

Whether you're organizing daily tasks, managing projects, or creating your own workflows for note-taking, NF-Calendar gives you complete control over how your daily notes are created and organized.

Everything you might need to work with them is included in this plugin. It replaces a whole series of existing plugins and implements features that are currently unavailable among community plugins.

This is just the beginning, and I'm looking forward to the project’s future development!
